title: crupina intermedia
intro: Crupina intermedia, commonly known as thistle-thistle or yellow thistle, is a plant species within the sunflower family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Crupina intermedia include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
